import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price distribution by sensor type
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sensor_order = df.groupby('sensor_type')['price_usd'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', order=sensor_order, ax=ax1, palette='Set2')
ax1.set_title('Price Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Technology evolution: Megapixels over years
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
year_mp = df.groupby('model_year')['megapixels'].mean()
ax2.plot(year_mp.index, year_mp.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=4, color='#2E86AB')
ax2.set_title('Megapixel Evolution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Avg Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Price vs Megapixels scatter with sensor type
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
sensor_types = df['sensor_type'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', n_colors=len(sensor_types))
for i, sensor in enumerate(sensor_types):
    subset = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax3.scatter(subset['megapixels'], subset['price_usd'], alpha=0.6, 
               label=sensor, s=30, color=colors[i])
ax3.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax3.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', fontsize=8)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Brand market share
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
brand_counts = df['brand'].value_counts().head(8)
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('pastel', n_colors=len(brand_counts))
ax4.pie(brand_counts.values, labels=brand_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        startangle=90, colors=colors_pie, textprops={'fontsize': 8})
ax4.set_title('Top 8 Brands Market Share', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. 4K video capability by year
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
video_4k_year = df.groupby('model_year')['has_video_4k'].mean() * 100
ax5.bar(video_4k_year.index, video_4k_year.values, color='#A23B72', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax5.set_title('4K Video Adoption Rate', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('% with 4K', fontsize=10)
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 6. Weight vs Price colored by body type
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
body_types = df['body_type'].unique()
colors_body = sns.color_palette('Set1', n_colors=len(body_types))
for i, body in enumerate(body_types):
    subset = df[df['body_type'] == body]
    ax6.scatter(subset['weight_grams'], subset['price_usd'], alpha=0.6,
               label=body, s=30, color=colors_body[i])
ax6.set_title('Weight vs Price by Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax6.legend(fontsize=8)
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 7. Max ISO distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax7.hist(df['max_iso'], bins=30, color='#F18F01', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax7.set_title('Max ISO Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax7.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

plt.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
